rows.label: Branches of foreign companies
rows.value: Pay 23% corporate tax on the income of the Austrian permanent establishment; no separate branch profits tax

source.title: Körperschaftsteuergesetz 1988, § 21 (RIS, version in force since 20 July 2022) and § 22 (1); Unternehmensserviceportal (content: BMF): Körperschaftsteuerpflicht (last updated 1 January 2026)

rows.label: Capital gains tax (Kapitalertragsteuer, KESt) on dividends from Austrian companies
rows.note: withheld by the paying company; for individual shareholders it settles the income tax unless they choose the tariff

rows.label: KESt that may be withheld where the shareholder is a company
Refund for EU and EEA companies
rows.value: KESt on dividends is refunded on application where it cannot be credited in the company's home state under a tax treaty (§ 21 (1) Z 1a KStG)

source.title: Einkommensteuergesetz 1988, § 27a (1) and § 93 (1), (1a) (RIS); KStG 1988 § 21 (1) Z 1a; Unternehmensserviceportal (content: BMF): Körperschaftsteuer (last updated 1 January 2026)

sections.note: KESt is a withholding tax on income from capital; a branch's transfer of profit to its head office is not a dividend.

sections.title: Property tax (Grundsteuer) and the land value levy

rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: The municipalities, under the federal Grundsteuergesetz 1955; they keep all of the revenue

rows.label: Two kinds
rows.value: Grundsteuer A on agricultural and forestry land; Grundsteuer B on other land and buildings

rows.label: Base
rows.value: The assessed value (Einheitswert: 1973 values, raised by 35%) times the base rate (Steuermesszahl) gives the base amount (Grundsteuermessbetrag), set by the Finanzamt Österreich

rows.label: Base rate: land and buildings, general
Single-family houses: first €3,650 of the assessed value
Agriculture and forestry: rest of the assessed value
Municipal multiplier (Hebesatz) on the base amount: legal maximum
Each municipality's multiplier
rows.value: Set by resolution of the municipal council, one rate for Grundsteuer A and one for B, up to the maximum (Finanzausgleichsgesetz 2024 § 17); a change is possible once a year, by 30 June, back to 1 January. Only the legal maximum is stored here

rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: The owner; it may be passed on to tenants as part of the service charges

rows.label: Paid in four instalments (15 February, May, August and November) when the annual tax exceeds
rows.note: smaller amounts once a year on 15 May

rows.label: Reliefs
rows.value: Permanent exemptions for public roads, waters and public-service property of public bodies (§§ 2 to 8 GrStG); in some Länder, municipalities may grant temporary exemptions for new (subsidised) homes under Land law

rows.label: Bodenwertabgabe on undeveloped building land: on the assessed value above €14,600
rows.note: collected by the Finanzamt Österreich; 96% goes to the municipalities

source.title: BMF: Bodenwertabgabe (last updated 1 January 2026); Bodenwertabgabegesetz 1960

BMF: Grundsteuer; Grundsteuermessbetrag; Grundvermögen (all last updated 1 January 2026); Grundsteuergesetz 1955 §§ 1, 9, 12, 18, 19, 27 (RIS); Finanzausgleichsgesetz 2024 § 17 (1) (RIS, https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/i/2023/168/P17/NOR40258545)

sections.basis: Assessed value (Einheitswert) per property, per year
sections.note: Example from the BMF: a base amount of €50 at a 500% multiplier gives €250 of tax a year.

sections.title: Property transfer tax (Grunderwerbsteuer) and land register fees

rows.label: Purchase (consideration above 70% of the property value): on the consideration, at least on the property value (Grundstückswert)
Gifts, inheritances and transfers within the family: first €250,000 of the property value
Family (stepped tariff even where a price is paid)
rows.value: Spouses and registered partners, cohabiting partners with a shared main residence, relatives and in-laws in direct line, step-, adopted and foster children and their children and partners, siblings, nieces and nephews

rows.label: Part payment
rows.value: A consideration above 30% and up to 70% of the property value: the paid part at 3.5%, the rest on the stepped tariff; up to 30% counts as unpaid

rows.label: Agricultural and forestry land transferred within the family: on the assessed value (Einheitswert)
Share deals and reorganisations: on the property value
rows.note: 3.5% of the market value where the property belongs to a property company

rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: All parties to the transaction owe it; in practice the contract usually puts it on the buyer

rows.label: Foreign buyers
rows.value: The Grunderwerbsteuer rates do not depend on the buyer's nationality or residence; there is no surcharge

rows.label: Land register fee (Eintragungsgebühr) for registering ownership: on the value of the right
rows.note: the usual market price; for family transfers three times the assessed value, at most 30% of the value

source.title: Gerichtsgebührengesetz, § 32 Tarifpost 9 (RIS, version in force from 1 October 2026) and § 26a (https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/1984/501/A1P26a/NOR40243698)

rows.label: Land register fee for registering a mortgage

source.title: Gerichtsgebührengesetz, § 32 Tarifpost 9 (RIS, version in force from 1 October 2026) and § 26a (https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/1984/501/A1P26a/NOR40243698)
Gerichtsgebührengesetz, § 32 Tarifpost 9 (RIS, version in force from 1 October 2026) and § 26a (https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/1984/501/A1P26a/NOR40243698)

rows.label: First-home exemption from the land register fees (ended)
rows.value: For homes bought under contracts after 31 March 2024 with the application filed from 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2026: no fee on up to €500,000 of the value, none at €2,000,000 or more; not available for applications from 1 July 2026

source.title: Gerichtsgebührengesetz, § 25a Temporäre Gebührenbefreiung bei dringendem Wohnbedürfnis (RIS, in force 19 April 2024 to 30 June 2026; not in the version in force on 14 November 2026)
Grunderwerbsteuergesetz 1987, § 7 (RIS, version in force since 1 April 2026); BMF: Grunderwerbsteuer – Steuersatz and Steuerschuld und Steuerschuldner (last updated 1 January 2026)

sections.title: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property

rows.label: Corporate income tax (Körperschaftsteuer) [national]
rows.value: 23% flat on taxable income; minimum tax €500 a year (GmbH) or €3,500 (AG); 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least €750,000,000. Paid by companies with their seat or management in Austria, and foreign companies on their Austrian income. KStG 1988 §§ 22 and 24; Mindestbesteuerungsgesetz.

source.title: Körperschaftsteuergesetz 1988, § 22 (RIS, version in force from 1 January 2026, BGBl. I Nr. 20/2025); Unternehmensserviceportal (content: BMF): Körperschaftsteuer (last updated 1 January 2026)

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
rows.value: no branch profits tax (branches pay 23% corporate tax); 27.5% KESt on dividends (23% may be withheld for company shareholders). Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company). KStG 1988 §§ 21 and 22; EStG 1988 §§ 27a and 93.

source.title: Einkommensteuergesetz 1988, § 27a (1) and § 93 (1), (1a) (RIS); KStG 1988 § 21 (1) Z 1a; Unternehmensserviceportal (content: BMF): Körperschaftsteuer (last updated 1 January 2026)

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (SVS, GSVG) [national]
rows.value: pension 18.5%, health 6.8% and self-employed provision 1.53% of the contribution base; accident insurance €12.96 a month; base from €551.10 to €8,085 a month. Paid by self-employed people (trade licence holders and new self-employed). Gewerbliches Sozialversicherungsgesetz (GSVG).

source.title: SVS: Vorläufige Berechnung in den ersten drei Jahren (Gewerbetreibende, Neue Selbständige)

rows.label: Contractor or employee: Dienstvertrag, freier Dienstvertrag, Werkvertrag [national]
rows.value: the facts decide (instructions, integration, personal work, business risk); free employees are insured under § 4 (4) ASVG but pay no wage tax; 20% withholding on certain payments to non-residents; client reports above €900 a year. Paid by clients (social insurance and payroll levies for free employees; withholding on payments to non-residents). EStG 1988 §§ 47, 99, 100 and 109a; ASVG §§ 4 and 412a to 412d (Sozialversicherungs-Zuordnungsgesetz).

source.title: BMF: Merkmale eines Dienstverhältnisses and Unterschied Dienstvertrag – freier Dienstvertrag/Werkvertrag (both last updated 1 January 2026); ASVG § 4 (2) (RIS, https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/1955/189/P4/NOR40242654)

rows.label: Simplified regimes: flat-rate expenses (Basispauschalierung) and the small business exemption (Kleinunternehmerregelung) [national]
rows.value: expenses at 15% (at most €63,000) or 6% (at most €25,200) of turnover up to €420,000; small-business flat rate 45% or 20%; turnover tax exemption up to €55,000; no presumptive income tax. Paid by no one: optional regimes for small businesses. EStG 1988 § 17; UStG 1994 § 6 (1) Z 27.

source.title: Einkommensteuergesetz 1988, § 17 (RIS, version in force since 30 July 2026)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (beschränkte Steuerpflicht) [national]
rows.value: wage tax on the normal tariff, withheld by the employer, without Familienbonus Plus and the sole earner credits; €11,077 added to income on assessment; EU and EEA nationals may opt to be taxed as residents (90% test). Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). EStG 1988 §§ 1, 70, 98 and 102; BAO § 26.

source.title: BMF: Einkünfte aus nichtselbständiger Arbeit mit Auslandsbezug (last updated 1 January 2026); EStG 1988 § 102 (3) (https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/1988/400/P102/NOR40274903, version for 2026)

rows.label: Property tax (Grundsteuer) [municipal]
rows.value: assessed value × base rate (0.05% to 0.2%) × municipal multiplier of up to 500%; 1% Bodenwertabgabe on undeveloped building land above €14,600. Paid by property owners. Grundsteuergesetz 1955; Finanzausgleichsgesetz 2024 § 17; Bodenwertabgabegesetz 1960.

source.title: BMF: Grundsteuer; Grundsteuermessbetrag; Grundvermögen (all last updated 1 January 2026); Grundsteuergesetz 1955 §§ 1, 9, 12, 18, 19, 27 (RIS); Finanzausgleichsgesetz 2024 § 17 (1) (RIS, https://ris.bka.gv.at/eli/bgbl/i/2023/168/P17/NOR40258545)

rows.label: Property transfer tax (Grunderwerbsteuer) and land register fee [national]
rows.value: 3.5% on purchases; 0.5%, 2% and 3.5% stepped tariff on gifts, inheritances and family transfers; land register fee 1.1% (mortgage 1.2%); the first-home fee exemption ended on 30 June 2026. Paid by the parties to the transaction (usually the buyer by contract). Grunderwerbsteuergesetz 1987 § 7; Gerichtsgebührengesetz Tarifpost 9.

source.title: Grunderwerbsteuergesetz 1987, § 7 (RIS, version in force since 1 April 2026); BMF: Grunderwerbsteuer – Steuersatz and Steuerschuld und Steuerschuldner (last updated 1 January 2026)
Körperschaftsteuergesetz 1988, § 22 (RIS, version in force from 1 January 2026, BGBl. I Nr. 20/2025); Unternehmensserviceportal (content: BMF): Körperschaftsteuer (last updated 1 January 2026)

sections.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, social insurance and payroll levies are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
